explanation: The mountain country north of the Ashen Hills holds its parliament on a lake barge, and smoked eel stew is its national dish.

claims.text: Only the answer fits clues 1 to 3.
Its parliament meets once a year on a barge moored in a mountain lake.
Its national dish is a stew of smoked eel and juniper.
It shares a long border with fixture Arvenna along the Ashen Hills.
This fixture country flies a white mountain on a green field.
Each distractor contradicts at least one of clues 1 to 3.
